# Power & oil
[textlink="Back to Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"]
## One machine at a time [bold]Generation → cables and distribution → machine → output storage.[/bold]
Make or obtain a generator, establish power, then add one processing machine. Supply its listed items and fluids; select the recipe or circuit it needs. Expand after that first machine runs reliably.
Motors, circuits, cables and machine casing parts are the building blocks. Use the [textlink="recipe finder" link="CMUGuideIndustryRecipes"] to plan them before building the whole factory.
## Oil becomes more than fuel [bold]Oil deposit → pump → distillation → fuel and chemical processing.[/bold]
Distillation splits crude into several products. Plan tanks and outlets for the byproducts as well as the product you want. Further processing makes fuels and polymer materials.
## Less carrying, more making Conveyors, filters and machine input/output settings move materials between stages. Keep outputs clear: a powered machine can still stop when it has nowhere to put its product.
